warnings: Dates for the 4 in-class tests are not listed in the syllabus; check Canvas for announcements.
Final exam date/time is determined by the university registrar during the exam period (December 10 to 19).
Individual schedules for biweekly Laboratories (starting Sept 14) and Tutorials (5 sessions starting Sept 21) are determined separately on Canvas.
Must obtain at least 50% overall AND at least 50% on the total lab mark to pass the course.
